text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage with antimuscarinic agents, including Trospium Chloride Extended-Release Capsules, can result in severe antimuscarinic effects. Supportive treatment should be provided according to symptoms. In the event of overdosage, ECG monitoring is recommended.
